confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from Albufeira-specific Numbeo figures and Algarve cost guides in search results (EUR, mixed dates), cross-checked against Livingcost and Where and When, with a July peak-season uplift. Sources disagree and some are older or regional. Beer assumes a standard draught of about 0.5 L. Cocktail and wine rest on guide ranges and the local beer relationship. Accommodation values are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from any accommodation search or live listings. EUR-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.16, not a searched rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Albufeira-specific cost snapshots cross-checked against Algarve resort guides, with a July peak-season uplift. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of comparable Algarve resort towns in peak season.
